t: A tiny chip that pairs a small brain with a long-range LoRa radio.
steps: Find a Heltec CubeCell HTCC-AB01 V1 board from a leftover listing or reuse one you have.
Screw on the LoRa antenna before you power the board.
Get a micro USB cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the Heltec CubeCell board package.
Choose the CubeCell Board from the menu and set your region's radio band.
Open the LoRaWAN example and enter your network keys from The Things Network.
Upload the sketch and watch for your first message on the network console.
meta: Open Board. From $51.99. A few stores.
